g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-406 Metal detector conveyor (built frame, used head) · rev B
SS 304 (ASTM A240 sheet + plate / A554 tube / A276 bar)
No product contact (pack closed): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
Ø11 THRU (GEARMOTOR LUG, CONFIRM ON P1-420)

svg.text: The arm takes reaction torque only (≈ 9 N·m); the rubber bush lets the hollow shaft float.

g.text: ON THE SHAFT, KEY 6 + 2 SET SCREWS H12
TORQUE ARM 401 TO THE LEG, H13
UCFL204 ON THE INSIDE OF THE EAR (HIDDEN)

svg.text: Plate 160 x 210 with 4 x Ø6.6 for the box (H10); welded tab 40 x 20 x 16 standoff to the -y infeed leg, Ø9 (M8).
2 clamp brackets (U-bolts H11) to the infeed +y leg; top: stack light P1-461 base; cable inside the tube, grommet at the bottom.
1. Gearmotor: clean the shaft, anti-seize on the bore, slide on with the key 6 x 6 x 30; set screws H12 with Loctite 243, 4 N·m.
2. Torque arm: bolt to the leg with the rubber bush; the bush must not be crushed (8 N·m). The arm must never carry the motor weight.
3. Controls box: fit the bracket to the -y infeed leg before mounting the box; glands face down; lid toward the operator.
4. Beacon pole: cable inside the tube, grommet at the bottom; light top at z ≈ 1,450, seen from the whole bench.
